title: feat(nsopyex): opposite-lock y-probe later-tick exist-opposite: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: First HOLD/HOLD in the campaign by PR number, and the verdict is degenerate: the runner's own output shows S_*(A)=S_*(B)={+e_1,+e_2,-e_2,+e_3,-e_3} and S_*(C)=S_*(D)={+e_1,-e_1,+e_2,+e_3,-e_3}. Each set already contains an axis in both orientations, so the existential-opposite predicate is satisfied by either set against itself and carries no information about the A-B or C-D relation.
